name: Covertype (Forest CoverType)
description: The Forest CoverType dataset contains cartographic variables for predicting forest cover type from strictly cartographic variables (as opposed to remotely sensed data). It includes 581,012 observations with 54 features describing 30x30 meter cells derived from USFS and USGS data across Roosevelt National Forest in Colorado.
